geometry: Opaque 681 by 573 vertical gradient (#27ab5f to #249a56) under an explicit triangular lattice measured from the source (vertical lines every 28.73 px from x=24, vertices every 32.23 px from y=27, odd columns offset by half), white at 9.5% opacity, 1.7 px wide; 16 lighter two-triangle facets in the source's cells at 10% white; geometric white emblem with a filter-free drop shadow (three stacked offsets around 8 px); explicitly drawn logo lettering, handwritten-style paths and a smile.
limitations: Uses no <pattern>, <filter>, <mask> or <clipPath>, since Qt5's SVG renderer ignores them; the shadow approximates the source's blur with stacked translucent copies. Handwritten lettering remains a simplified approximation.
